_metadata.description: Brand-to-scenario assignment ledger: which brand (at which version) is linked to which scenario and what was actually applied.

requirements.title: Link a brand at a specific version to a scenario
requirements.description: An assignment record links a scenario to a brand at a pinned brand version, and re-assigning updates the link rather than creating a duplicate.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/assignments/service_test.go once the assignments domain is ported.

requirements.title: Track which elements were applied, when, and at what version
requirements.description: Each assignment records the set of applied elements (colors, typography, logo, favicon, design-doc), the applied-at timestamp, and the brand version applied, supporting partial (per-element) application.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/assignments/applied_test.go once applied-element tracking is ported.

requirements.title: Report per-scenario branding assignment status
requirements.description: A scenario-status query returns whether a scenario has an assigned brand, which version is assigned, and whether the applied version is behind the brand's current version (drift).

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/assignments/status_test.go once scenario-status is ported.
